name: B10-0151/2025 (ESN) – White paper on the future of European defence
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text:
This is a non-binding motion from a political group, not a law. It calls on EU member states to build their own defence capabilities, create a European Defence Alliance, and set up a forum of national defence ministers without supranational powers. It also demands an investigation into whether US-funded groups like USAID and NED interfered in European elections and media, and wants the EU's diplomatic service to stop working with USAID.

- Nothing changes yet; it is a set of requests and opinions with no legal force.
- It targets member states, EU institutions, and US-funded media and democracy groups.
- Next, it goes to EU leaders and governments; they are not obliged to act.
